title: All my Friends are Static
overview: Roxane, an aspiring analog horror creator, struggles to gain traction online. Desperate for authenticity, she convinces her friend Clarence to help stage a “real” horror video in a morgue. When it’s empty, she spirals, forcing him into a body bag while filming his panic. Reality begins to distort through her lens. Clarence escapes, but Roxane stays, sealing herself inside. When the footage is uploaded, she has become the horror she sought.
